About astrology on Astrowani

Different questions need different readings

Not every question belongs to the same tradition. A birth chart is the right place to start if you want to understand patterns across your life, so an online Kundli reading walks through your planetary positions, houses and current dasha with an astrologer who can explain what each one actually means for you. If the question is about marriage, Kundli matching compares two charts through traditional Ashtakoot Guna Milan rather than reducing them to a score.

Some questions do not need a birth chart at all. Tarot card reading works from the question itself, which makes it a common starting point when a birth time is uncertain or when you want to think through one specific decision. Numerology reads the numbers behind your date of birth and the spelling of your name. Both are separate traditions from Vedic astrology, and a good consultant will tell you where they agree and where they do not.

For practical matters there are practical readings. Career and business astrology looks at the houses traditionally associated with work, income and partnership, and is most useful against a concrete decision rather than a general outlook. Vastu consultation covers the orientation and layout of a home or workplace, and works well remotely because most of it is read from a floor plan. Lal Kitab reads the same chart by its own rules and is known for remedies that are deliberately simple. Palm reading needs no birth details at all, which makes it the one reading open to somebody who does not know their birth time. For timing a new beginning, the Panchang and Muhurat are where most people start.

Why people choose Astrowani

Every astrologer on the platform is reviewed before they can take a consultation, and our criteria are deliberately narrow — there are fewer astrologers here than on larger platforms, and that is the intention rather than a shortcoming. You can read each profile, see their specialisation, experience and the languages they work in, and choose for yourself before anything starts.

A consultation runs the way that suits you: a private chat, a phone call or a video session. You are billed only for the minutes you actually spend talking, you can end a session from your side at any time, and your wallet is tied to your phone number — so a recharge on the website is there the moment you open the app. If you would rather browse first, the free tools and calculators ask nothing of you.

What a reading is, and what it is not

Astrology has been used for generations as a way of reflecting on life through planetary positions, zodiac signs and traditional interpretation. It is a cultural and spiritual practice, and that is how the astrologers here are asked to present it — as tendencies and context rather than as fixed outcomes.

It does not replace professional advice where that is what a situation calls for, and nobody on this platform should tell you otherwise. Your decisions, your effort and your circumstances remain the things that shape what happens next. A reading is there to help you think, not to think for you.
